messages.content:
You are an expert synthetic chemist planning experiments to maximise reaction yield.
Each experiment chooses one option for every variable listed. You will see the results
of experiments already run. Choose the next batch to find the highest-yield conditions
in as few experiments as possible. Use chemical knowledge (ligand and base effects,
substrate reactivity, solvent effects) and the observed results. Balance exploiting
good regions with testing informative new combinations. Never repeat an experiment.
Return JSON only.

Pd-catalysed Buchwald-Hartwig amination of 1-ethyl-4-iodobenzene with 4-methylaniline; choose the ligand, base and isoxazole additive.

Variables and options:
ligand:
L1: tBuBrettPhos [SMILES CC(C)C(C=C(C(C)C)C=C1C(C)C)=C1C2=C(P(C(C)(C)C)C(C)(C)C)C(OC)=CC=C2OC]

picks.reason: Tests a simple 5-phenylisoxazole against the strong L4/B3 benchmark.
Compares the 3-phenyl isomer with the already-tested 4-phenyl isomer under the best conditions.
Tests whether the dibenzylamino substituent on a 5-isoxazole improves the leading catalyst system.
Contrasts the 3-dibenzylamino isomer with the 5-substituted analogue.
Evaluates a fused benzisoxazole additive with the established top ligand and base.
Tests the benzisoxazole constitutional isomer under the best-performing conditions.
Checks whether a small dimethylisoxazole retains useful additive activity without an ester group.
Tests 5-methylisoxazole as a simpler analogue of the strong ester-containing additives.
Probes a 3-methyl-5-phenylisoxazole analogue under the benchmark conditions.
Tests the unsubstituted 3-methylisoxazole analogue of the leading additive motif.
Evaluates a 5-furyl, 3-carboxylate isoxazole as a heteroaryl analogue of the effective ester additives.
Compares the 5-thienyl carboxylate analogue with the furyl additive under benchmark conditions.
Tests whether the near-leading L2 ligand improves the already promising A9 additive result.
Checks the L2/B3 combination with a positional ester isomer that performed well with L4.
Tests ligand–additive interaction for the methoxy-substituted ester analogue.
Checks whether L2 improves the moderate-yield methyl isoxazole carboxylate result.
Measures whether L1's strong performance with A13 extends to the promising A9 additive.
Tests the A17 ester isomer with another ligand that performed well on A13.
Explores a ligand change for A8, which showed moderate yield with L2 and B3.
Tests whether the lower A11 result was due to its base choice by pairing it with the best-performing base.
